recommendations.text: Resume nutrition logging immediately. 34 consecutive days (since Aug 23) without any logged intake while on a GLP-1 agonist that suppresses appetite. Cannot verify protein floor (1.6 g/kg = 161 g/day at 100.8 kg) or energy availability. On Wegovy, a zero-intake log may reflect genuine under-eating, not only a logging gap.
